subject.title: Feature Request: Add cumulative history search and multi-account support

question: Should cumulative history be implemented as federated read-only search across immutable snapshots, or should the primary archive become an append/merge store, and should multi-account profiles be tracked as a separate feature?
rationale: These choices determine deletion semantics, message identity, backup compatibility, storage growth, command UX, and whether the current point-in-time archive contract changes for existing users.

options.title: Federate snapshots; split profiles
options.body: Preserve the current live archive and backup format, add deduplicated cross-snapshot search first, and track named multi-account profiles separately.

options.title: Build cumulative profile archives
options.body: Redesign storage around account-scoped append/merge archives with migrations and explicit deletion/update rules before adding search.

options.title: Keep manual isolation only
options.body: Retain --db and --source as the multi-account mechanism and scope this issue solely to historical snapshot search.

recommendation.title: Federate snapshots; split profiles
recommendation.body: Preserve the current live archive and backup format, add deduplicated cross-snapshot search first, and track named multi-account profiles separately.

likelyOwner.reason: The current snapshot and restore architecture primarily comes from this person's merged backup work.
